name: Reverse Hyperextension
steps: Lie face down on the machine with your hip creases at the edge of the pad and grasp the handles.
Position your ankles in the strap or against the roller and let your legs hang beneath your hips.
Brace your trunk and lift your legs behind you until they line up with your torso.
Lower your legs slowly back under control to the bottom stretch without letting the pendulum yank your lower back.
tips: Stop lifting once your legs reach horizontal in line with your torso rather than arching sharply into your lower back.
Control the downward swing smoothly instead of letting heavy weight whip your pelvis underneath the pad.
